crime_highlights: Mr. Gladue killed Ms. West in her own home where she should have felt secure and safe
The killing was an act of extreme violence, as is reflected by the at least 33 stab wounds to Ms. West's body
Mr. Gladue covered her body with a blanket. He then poured bleach on the blanket and around the body
Her body was not discovered for six days
Ms. West's family has been significantly impacted by her murder
rationale_highlights: It details Mr. Gladue's difficult personal history and family relationships
Mr. Gladue is an Indigenous man whose background of early substance abuse is all too prevalent in the Indigenous persons coming before the courts
note: Gladue factor only listed as agreed mitigating; no explicit statement of effect on sentence.

crime_highlights: Ms. Hartford bit off a large portion of Ms. Baalim's ear
She also bit Ms. Baalim's nose and struck her numerous times in the head, causing a number of injuries
she suffered serious and disfiguring injuries
rationale_highlights: Ms. Hartford experienced a difficult upbringing
She was removed from her biological family and placed in the foster care system which, as noted by Ms. Smith, contributed to a gradual separation from her Aboriginal culture

in recognition of your difficult history, your guilty plea, and your commitment to putting yourself on a better path going forward, I agree that the sentence proposed by your lawyer and by Crown adequately addresses the principles of sentencing
note: Court's recognition of difficult history is brief.

crime_highlights: They both returned inside the residence, each carrying a shotgun
Mr. Boffa retrieved the two shotguns which had been inside the bag and handed one to Mr. Stump
Mr. Boffa had his shotgun raised and pointed at Mr. Baldwin
he shot Mr. Baldwin twice, killing him
rationale_highlights: He is an aboriginal person who had what could fairly be described as a horrendous childhood
He probably suffers from FASD due to his mother's substance abuse during her pregnancy with him

The moral culpability of Mr. Stump, in carrying a shotgun into Mr. Baldwin's residence, and in effect peripherally aiding Mr. Boffa in the killing, is relatively low, as compared to other manslaughter cases
there are significant mitigating factors here
